attributes.context: It appears in Article 14, Pipe Cutting and Fabrication, which assigns pipe handling, cutting, threading, joining, fabrication, and installation to Local No. 1 Journeymen and Apprentices and imposes labeling and shop requirements for off-site pipe work.

extraction_text: 59. MATERIALS, TOOLS, PIPE MACHINES AND EQUIPMENT PROVISIONS: All materials, tools, pipe machines and equipment shall be permitted in “the area” covered by this Agreement, provided the materials, tools, pipe and equipment machines are in compliance with City, State and Federal codes and safety and health regulations. A Joint Committee will be appointed to review all new materials, tools, pipe machines and equipment.
